title: haex-hive Consumer Manifest v2
description: Schema for a consumer repository's .haex-hive.json v2 file. See spec-007 FR-001..FR-006.

haex_hive_version.description: Schema version. Must be the exact string "2".

haex_hive_min_version.description: Minimum CLI version required. Grammar: X.Y.Z or >=X.Y.Z. See FR-006.

atoms.description: The explicit allowlist of atoms this project inherits. Empty allowed.

groups.description: v1 carry-over; not consumed by Spec 007 commands.

versionConstraint.description: Exact X.Y.Z or lower-bound >=X.Y.Z. See FR-006/R10.

canonicalSourceUrl.description: Canonical source URL (lowercase scheme+host, no trailing /, no terminal .git, no userinfo). Runtime canonicalizer is authoritative; this pattern is a schema-level guard against the most common violations.

track.description: Optional non-authoritative branch annotation. Never overrides revision.

config.description: Per-atom-id config overrides. Keys must be atom-ids resolved by this entry's includes.

priority.description: Consumer-owned priority override (D5). Publisher config_schema MUST NOT declare a top-level priority property.

values.description: Deep-merged onto publisher defaults; validated against publisher config_schema after merge.
